newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury yr forecasts eye 710-725 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury yr forecasts eye 710-725 mln stg.

text.p: Analysts are converging on year profit forecasts for J. Sainsbury Plc at around 710-725 million pounds after half-year figures were released on Wednesday, market sources said.

Several analysts were reported to have brought forecasts down by 10-20 million stg while others were already within the above range, the sources said, but analysts were not immediately available to confirm.
"The range we have heard is 710-720 million stg," said one sector analyst who asked not to be named.
Sainsbury said on Wednesday half-year pretax profits had slipped to 393 million stg from 456 million stg, as expected, and paid out a dividend of 3.5 pence, up from 3.4 pence.
It said current like-for-like sales in its supermarkets had grown in line with inflation at three percent, compared with a 7.5 percent gain reported by arch-rival Tesco in September.
But Sainsbury shares nevertheless showed gains in a market easing after a surprise quarter-point rise in UK base rates, rising eight pence to 363 pence by 1348 GMT.
Analysts said the group had taken intiatives to help longer term prospects.
Chairman David Sainsbury told Reuters the current financial year would focus on the basics while next year would be about getting profits moving.
